items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: He worked with you, didn't he, for a long time? ... Oh, I knew Manzi. ... But he worked in the theater where.

ctx.x: In the theater where you were then? That's where I was. You were in the pit orchestra sort of there? Yes. I remember people tell me, and I did once hearing, Manzi Campbell. Yes, the drummer. He worked with you, didn't he, for a long time?
Oh, I knew Manzi. Manzi came from Bill Cassancho. Oh, is that right? That's where he was. He and his brother. He had a brother that played there.
They called him Bunker, I believe.
